name: Shiva Gayatri
text:
ॐ तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि ।
तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् ॥
meaning: We seek to know the supreme presence and meditate upon Mahadeva. May Rudra inspire and guide our understanding.
purpose: A devotional Gayatri-style invocation focused on insight and inspiration.
supports: Clear thinking; thoughtful decisions; self-reflection; awareness before reacting.
when: Before meditation, journaling or reflective work.
note: Gayatri-style formulas vary across traditions; this is the wording of the client library, one commonly circulated form.
